tagline: Every throw. Every rival. Every result.
description:
Score Arena turns a phone into a shared scorekeeper for games played around a real dartboard or a board game table. Start a room with Game Hub profiles, choose the order, enter every throw and keep the complete result in each player's history.

Choose from Darts 301 or 501, Cricket, Bitcoin Darts, Breakdown, Around the Clock, 18-hole Pro Golf and 9-hole Mini Golf. Each mode has its own rules, live targets, help and personal performance statistics.

Board games get the same treatment. Pick a ready-made game such as Scrabble, Yahtzee, Catan, Carcassonne or Azul and Score Arena keeps the scores and the winner while you play at a real table. Need something else? Design your own game by choosing where scores start, whether they count up or down, and whether it ends at a target score, after a set number of rounds or when you decide. Everyone who plays it sees it in their own history and statistics.

Practising alone no longer means playing against an empty table. Add the Ghost for a simulated rival that throws at a real dartboard: it aims where a player would, at T20, at the checkout double or at the next Cricket number, and its darts scatter around that spot, so small beds are hard to hit and a missed treble lands in the single or the neighbouring wedge. You see where it aimed and where each dart stuck. The size of that scatter comes from your own last fifteen matches in the selected mode, so on average the Ghost plays at your level, and its form rises and falls during the match. The Ghost never becomes a profile or pollutes the player directory; only your own result is saved.
capabilities: Darts 301 and 501 with bust rules, double-out and checkout suggestions.
Cricket for two to eight players with marks and open-target scoring.
Bitcoin Darts with highlighted mining targets, adaptive difficulty, block rewards and halvings.
Breakdown and Around the Clock with live target guidance.
18-hole Pro Golf and 9-hole Mini Golf with per-hole strokecards.
A Ghost opponent for solo practice that aims and throws at a real dartboard, matched to your own recent average, with every dart shown where it landed and a form that changes during the match.
Cricket against the Ghost shows both players' marks on the board, taking turns where you both have marks on a number.
Mode-specific personal statistics before every game.
Best-of match lengths and a complete turn history.
Responsive dartboard designed for phones and larger screens.
Save and resume an unfinished solo game.
Fourteen ready-made board games, including Scrabble, Yahtzee, Catan, Ticket to Ride, Carcassonne and Azul.
Custom games with your own starting score, direction, target, number of rounds and winner rule.
One phone can score for everyone at the table, including favourite players who are not in the room.
Statistics for every game, kept by Score Arena itself and shown before you start.
Profile results, wins, losses and head-to-head history through Game Hub.
Available in all nine mvmOS languages.
